column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: one subtest per dialect, so mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set (skipped: /mysql, /mssql). Declared rather than left unattributed for the same reason TestEgressAllowWorksOnEveryDialect is: `queue` is ABSENT from ported.go on the claim that it goes entirely through engine's dialect-aware store, and this is the test that claim is supposed to have behind it. Guards the management half of cleat#1116 -- a queues table nobody can populate is a table rather than a feature.
